fusions.name: Tacking Needle
fusions.desc: Flicks a threaded needle that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Measure Twice, Cut Once
fusions.desc: A shear cut that deals 28 damage and is always a critical hit, leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tailored Gambeson
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 8% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Stitch
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a stitch on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stitch (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stitch fades every 6 seconds.
